title: Slovakian Sunday Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew originating from Slovakia, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon. This recipe is made with tender meat and fresh cilantro, served with a side of crusty bread.

ingredients.name: Sunday
ingredients.amount: 1 tablespoon, chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley or dill)

instructions: Heat oil in the pot over medium heat.
Add the caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the stew meat and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and Sunday herbs (if using).
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
